mapper.update: update rule_version set status = #{status}, disabled_at = null, auto_delete_at = null, disabled_from_status = null where rule_id = #{ruleId} and version = #{version}
mapper.select: select version, status from rule_version where rule_id = #{ruleId} and status = 'ENABLED' order by version desc limit 1
mapper.update: update rule set current_draft_version = #{version}, latest_version = #{version}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{ruleId}
update rule set current_draft_version = null, latest_version = null, status = 'DISABLED', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{ruleId}
mapper.delete: delete from rule_capability where rule_version_id in ( select rv.id from rule_version rv where rv.status = 'DISABLED' and rv.auto_delete_at is not null and rv.auto_delete_at <= #{now} )
delete from rule_target where rule_version_id in ( select rv.id from rule_version rv where rv.status = 'DISABLED' and rv.auto_delete_at is not null and rv.auto_delete_at <= #{now} )

delete from rule_runtime_status rrs where exists ( select 1 from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rrs.rule_id and rv.version = rrs.rule_version and rv.status = 'DISABLED' and rv.auto_delete_at is not null and rv.auto_delete_at <= #{now} )

delete from rule_instance_binding rib where exists ( select 1 from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rib.rule_id and rv.version = rib.rule_version and rv.status = 'DISABLED' and rv.auto_delete_at is not null and rv.auto_delete_at <= #{now} )
delete from rule_version where status = 'DISABLED' and auto_delete_at is not null and auto_delete_at <= #{now}
mapper.update: update rule r set current_draft_version = ( select rv.version from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = r.id and rv.status = 'ENABLED' order by rv.version desc limit 1 ), latest_version = ( select rv.version from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = r.id and rv.status = 'ENABLED' order by rv.version desc limit 1 ), status = coalesce(( select rv.status from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = r.id and rv.status = 'ENABLED' order by rv.version desc limit 1 ), 'DISABLED'), updated_at = #{updatedAt} where exists (select 1 from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = r.id)
mapper.delete: delete from rule_lock rl where not exists (select 1 from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = rl.rule_id)
delete from rule r where not exists (select 1 from rule_version rv where rv.rule_id = r.id)
